headline: Keep historical blend inventory diagnostics in the background

changes.title: Remove routine historical inventory audit from Vial Actions
changes.detail: Historical blend source evidence is assessed internally without showing an Inventory needs review task or asking users to manually audit old dose records.

changes.title: Preserve unknown historical physical amounts
changes.detail: Missing or mismatched source allocations remain unresolved; the read-only evidence engine never infers physical stock, reopens vials, rewrites historical doses or changes balances.

changes.title: Retain Deadpool and BAC-water accounting safeguards
changes.detail: The released exact-vial automatic-finish and per-vial BAC-water workflows remain unchanged and passed fictional full-app, writer, mobile, WebKit and next-day regression checks.

dataImpact: No migration, automatic stock correction, historical inventory reconciliation, reattribution, vial reopening or overwrite. Existing localStorage key peptide-tracker-html-v1 and records preserved. Ordinary user-confirmed doses continue to log as before. Isolated full-app DEMO uses fictional in-memory data with no production sync/import/writes.
limitations: Read-only diagnostic evidence is internal; no automatic stock-repair or on-demand exception prompt system is introduced.
Unknown physical vial contents cannot be established by incomplete historic logs; already-finished historical vials remain untouched.
PR169 multi-source Review/Undo remains a separate unmerged draft.
User confirmed physical iPhone review of Stash/Vial Actions and Log Dose with no issues. VoiceOver and real historical physical-stock accuracy were not tested.
Publication pending; primary Cloudflare exact merged-source parity must be independently verified after approved merge.
